projectState.summary: Byte L4b and Byte editor-ux-cleanup are approved and merged locally to main in order. The melody editor now opens from a visible Melody action through a compact player menu, the overlay is narrow and internally scroll-contained, and edit/catalog controls use progressive disclosure: catalog list inside the editor, Anchor/Connector panels collapsed until selection, Connector More for secondary knobs. Claude live-verified the UX at 821x942 and confirmed the boundary stayed presentation-only: no edit model, persistence/catalog semantics, renderer, scorer, transport, scheduling, server, or window.phraseEditor behavior changed. Validation before merge: build green, six unit suites green, full smoke 76/76 twice on a reused non-clean DB, db:smoke green, diff-check green; npm audit still reports known Vite/esbuild advisories.
